_source: Age rating answers for the group version (0.5.0 public: groups, server, parent mode, Declared Age Range). Keys are App Store Connect API AgeRatingDeclaration attribute names; .github/workflows/asc-metadata.yml sends `attributes` as they are. Copied over store/app-store/age-rating.json when GROUPS_PHASE becomes 'public' (src/__tests__/store-metadata.test.ts). parentalControls: parent mode (Ayarlar > Veli modu) locks group settings and limits group time. ageAssurance: the iOS Declared Age Range signal (K-17). userGeneratedContent: nickname and group name. messagingAndChat: ready-made reactions only, no free text (declared Yes to be safe, K-44). socialMedia: no feed, discovery, likes or comments. contests FREQUENT: the daily and weekly in-group ranking; this is the answer that makes the rating 13+. FREQUENT is the value of the current questionnaire (the API also lists FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE); check the asc-metadata dry run before the first apply.

notSet.kidsAgeBand: Not in the Kids category (K-45); left as it is.
notSet.socialMediaAgeRestricted: Only meaningful when socialMedia is true; left as it is.
notSet.ageRatingOverrideV2: No override; Apple's calculated rating is used.
notSet.koreaAgeRatingOverride: Not distributed with a Korea-specific rating; left as it is.
